item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 18/Oct/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, it will be windy and cooler over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. Tropical Cyclone Nesat will move across the seas south of Hainan Island, towards the vicinity of Beibu Wan and weaken gradually in the next couple of days. With Nesat departing Guangdong, the weather will improve over the coastal areas towards the weekend. An area of low pressure east of the Philippines is expected to develop gradually and may enter the South China Sea over the weekend to early next week. However, there are still uncertainties in its development and movement.
